info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Sodalite Racket Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Sodalite Racket Detail Management API allows businesses to manage detailed information about Sodalite rackets in their product catalog. This API facilitates the creation of new racket details, ensuring that all relevant specifications and descriptions are accurately recorded. Retailers and distributors can utilize this endpoint to enhance their product offerings and improve inventory management. The primary resource involves creating detailed descriptions for specific racket models, which helps in attracting customers and improving sales.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new detail entry for a sodalite racket. Please provide the necessary information in the request body to define the details of the sodalite racket.

requestBody.description: Provides the details for the sodalite racket. This operation requires that the request body adhere to the defined schema, ensuring the correct data format and structure are provided.

200.description: The request was processed successfully, returning the requested details.

CreateCatalogSodaliteRacketDetailRequest.title: Sodalite Racket Request Body

sodalite_racket_id.description: The unique identifier for the Sodalite racket.

requestedBy.description: The name or identifier of the person requesting the operation.

quantity.description: The number of Sodalite rackets requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request should be prioritized.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the Sodalite racket.

tags.description: A list of tags associated with the request for categorization.

items.description: A tag related to the Sodalite racket request.

CreateCatalogSodaliteRacketDetailRequest.description: This schema defines the structure for the request body used when creating a new operation for a Sodalite racket.

recordId.description: A unique identifier for the record that was processed.

CreateCatalogSodaliteRacketDetailRespons.description: This schema represents the response for a successful POST operation in the Racket application. It provides information about the status of the operation, the unique record identifier, the time the operation was processed, the count of matched records, and any warnings that were generated during the process.

content-type.description: Indicates the media type of the resource being returned. This specifies that the response body contains JSON formatted data.
